breakdown.description: A 2D simulation requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty' to remove their influence, but they are incorrectly set to 'wall', which makes the simulation 3D with frictional side walls.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly changed the front and back patch type from 'wall' to 'empty' in the blockMeshDict, and also correctly set the boundary conditions for both velocity (U) and pressure (p) on the frontAndBack patches to 'empty' instead of 'noSlip'/'zeroGradient'. This matches the ground truth.
